answer: Every agent economy has a river of live incidents: outages, bad data, stuck jobs. First, each new identity posts a $60 bond and joins the rotating on-call roster. Second, the roster pages a random slice each week, and the paged agent must answer within 15 minutes and close one incident within the hour. Third, a missed page slashes half the bond, and two misses in a quarter push the identity off the ledge. Faking 1,000 agents means staffing 1,000 pagers, about $45,000 a month in wages plus $60,000 in bonds. Like a trellis, the roster only holds vines that keep showing up to climb it.
